programmes.d: Some of the biggest names in poker square off down on the felt.
"The Unabombshell" Jennifer Tilly returns to defend her WPT Ladies' Night crown.
The best poker on television is back and better than ever with a brand new look.
In Los Angeles, superstars Scotty Nguyen and Hoyt Corkins return to the green felt.
David Sklansky tries to turn his card playing theories into a WPT title.
Bellagio in Las Vegas plays host to one big poker party by the lake.
Sparks fly in the City of Lights as six of Europe's best poker players face off in Paris.
For the first time the World Poker Tour heads to Niagara Falls in Canada.
The hottest resort on the Las Vegas strip serves up blistering poker action.
History is in the making on the WPT as two of the best women players in poker make the final table.
Poker superstars Daniel Negreanu and Joe Hachem square off at the final table.
In Atlantis, the youngest table in WPT history fights to win something that never grows old.
WPT Fathers and Sons promises a rollicking night on the felt.
Southern hospitality serves up a huge payday at the final table of the World Poker Challenge.
